lines.text: $|AG|:|GP|=2:1$, so $G$ divides $[AP]$ in the ratio $2:1$.
Let $P=(x,y)$. Then $G=\left(\frac{1\cdot 0+2x}{3},\ \frac{1\cdot 6+2y}{3}\right)$, and $G=\left(\frac23,\frac43\right)$.
